subject: Separate engine packaging, studies and showcase boundaries
description: Approved staged repository separation. Own pyproject/packaging, shared data/schema/metrics module moves and import updates, tests/docs/CI for those boundaries, study migration in an isolated studies worktree, and a new local showcase repository.
